findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: douyin_keyword_search · Public sink: bili_post_comments, bili_post_detail, ig_post_comments, ig_post_detail, tiktok_post_comments, tiktok_post_detail, tw_post_comments, tw_post_detail, yt_post_comments, yt_post_detail, weibo_post_comments, weibo_post_detail, ks_post_comments, ks_post_detail, douyin_keyword_search, zhihu_post_comments, zhihu_post_detail, channels_post_comments, channels_post_detail.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: douyin_keyword_search · Public sink: bili_post_comments, bili_post_detail, ig_post_comments, ig_post_detail, tiktok_post_comments, tiktok_post_detail, tw_post_comments, tw_post_detail, yt_post_comments, yt_post_detail, weibo_post_comments, weibo_post_detail, ks_post_comments, ks_post_detail, douyin_keyword_search, zhihu_post_comments, zhihu_post_detail, channels_post_comments, channels_post_detail

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
